entries.0f50d47583943cca: This business operates 3 hotels: “Just In Premium Nagoya Station”, “Just In Premium Toyohashi Station Shinkansen Exit” and “Just In Matsusaka Station Front”. The 4th hotel, “Just In Premium Tokai Ōtagawa Station Front” (Tokai City, Aichi Prefecture), commenced construction in April 2026 for opening in May 2027.
entries.105e05a9f3fcc944: This business operates the rental meeting room “Taimu Ofisu” (1 location in Nagoya City), the rental offices “Ofisu Purasu” (2 locations in Nagoya City), and monthly apartments with furniture and appliances, “Mansurī Purasu”. Operations are outsourced to Just In Co., Ltd. Amounts are not disclosed separately.
entries.4dba2467373e4832: This flow business plans, develops and sells urban condominiums for sale, residential lots and urban commercial buildings, and buys and sells real estate and brokers real estate transactions, earning revenue from each individual transaction. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended April 2026 was ¥3,535 million.
entries.5da2853816f56078: This stock business leases and manages real estate and operates rental meeting rooms, rental offices and monthly apartments. Operation of the rental meeting rooms, rental offices and monthly apartments is outsourced to the consolidated subsidiary Just In Co., Ltd. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended April 2026 was ¥589 million.
entries.616ddc91d6f137a3: This business provides property management for owners of urban condominiums sold by the Development segment (tenant recruitment, billing and collection of rent and common service charges, and building maintenance), building maintenance commissioned by management associations, leasing of properties it owns, operation of the indoor rental trunk room “Ｇｏｏｄ storage”, and contracting of repair, restoration and remodeling work on managed properties. Amounts are not disclosed separately.
entries.762f385857a4bd85: This business operates 3 business hotels under the “Just In” brand in Aichi and Mie prefectures. Operations are outsourced to the consolidated subsidiary Just In Co., Ltd. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended April 2026 was ¥1,374 million.
entries.82305a1a0d5b19a4: This business acquires land from real estate companies and individuals, plans and develops the 1K-type urban condominiums “Parutīru” and “Puroguresso” and the urban commercial building “Asutorāre”, and sells them mainly to real estate companies. Design supervision and construction work, among others, are outsourced to design firms and construction companies. Amounts are not disclosed separately.
entries.b1c4f2cb5a5f5949: A company that, mainly in Aichi Prefecture, develops and sells condominiums and residential land, leases and manages real estate, and operates business hotels.
entries.d460e93eecdee408: Jointly with the Investment Business, this business plans, develops and sells LDK-type urban condominiums “Parutīru”, plans, develops and sells residential lots “Riberuta”, and buys, resells and brokers detached houses, condominiums, income properties and others. Amounts are not disclosed separately.
